verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "What Is Ezekiel 25:17? “And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them,” reads the Bible’s King James Version." (R1); "Ezekiel 25:17 KJV - And I will execute great vengeance upon - Bible Gateway" (R2); "In the King James Bible, Ezekiel 25:17 reads: “And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes..." (R3); full chapter text including v17 (R4); multiple translations of Ezekiel 25:17 (R5); "Ezekiel 25:17 NKJV" (R6); "Ezekiel 25:17 monologue" as biblical reference in movie (R7)
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly identify and quote Ezekiel 25:17 as a verse from the Bible.

verifications.claim: Ezekiel 25:17 is focused on divine vengeance against nations that wronged Israel.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes..." (R1, quoting in vengeance context); "Thus I will execute great acts of vengeance on them... Because the Philistines acted vengefully and exacted vengeance with intentional malice, destroying with undying hostility" against Judah/Israel (R4); "A Prophecy Against the Philistines... I will execute great vengeance against them with furious reproof." (R5); similar in R3
verifications.reasoning: R4 and R5 provide chapter context of divine judgment/vengeance on Philistines (and prior nations like Ammon, Moab, Edom) for actions against Israel/Judah; R1/R3 reinforce vengeance theme.

verifications.claim: Many translations of Ezekiel 25:17 read "And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them" (KJV).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Exact KJV quote: "And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them." (R1, R2, R3); KJV listed exactly (R5); NKJV very similar: "I will execute great vengeance on them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I lay My vengeance upon them.” (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly quote the exact KJV wording; others show similar phrasing in various translations, confirming the claim.

verifications.claim: Ezekiel 25:17 is commonly confused with a fictionalized, violent monologue from the movie Pulp Fiction.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "quoted almost word-for-word a violent prayer used in Quentin Tarantino’s cult classic “Pulp Fiction” that’s loosely based on a Bible passage... adapted almost word-for-word from a violent monologue" (R1); "reciting a famous fictionalized Bible quote from "Pulp Fiction"... Jackson's character attributes the passage to Ezekiel 25:17. However, it is a fictionalized version" (R3); "Ezekiel 25:17, as quoted by Jules, is not in the Bible... fictionalized Ezekiel 25:17" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: R1, R3 describe real-world confusion/misattribution by Hegseth; R7 explains the movie's fictionalized version famously linked to the verse, leading to common confusion.
